kb.title: Build the Kit
kb.none: No shirt in this club's archive can be drawn from its documented details yet.
kb.intro.title: Build the shirt, season by season
kb.intro.body: You are given a season and a strip. Dress a blank shirt — colours, design, maker, sponsor — from what you know of the club. Then check it: the real shirt is revealed with its sources.
kb.intro.fine: Every shirt is a real kit from this club's documented archive ({n} can be drawn). Wrong cards are real too: other shirts the club wore.
kb.patternInfo.solid: One colour of cloth, no pattern.
kb.patternInfo.hoops: Horizontal bands of the second colour round the body.
kb.patternInfo.hoop-tonal: Horizontal bands woven in a slightly different tone of the same colour.
kb.patternInfo.stripe-wide: Broad vertical stripes in the second colour.
kb.patternInfo.twin-stripe: Two narrow vertical stripes down the middle of the chest.
kb.patternInfo.sash: One diagonal band from shoulder to hip.
kb.patternInfo.diagonal: Several slanted bands across the body.
kb.patternInfo.quarters: The shirt split into four blocks of two colours.
kb.patternInfo.halves: Two colours, one down each side.
kb.patternInfo.chest-band: A single horizontal band across the chest.
kb.patternInfo.shoulder-panel: Panels over the shoulders and down the sleeves.
kb.patternInfo.chevron: Stacked V-shaped bands across the chest.
kb.q.colours: Which colours did the {season} {variant} shirt wear?
kb.q.design: What was the design of the {season} {variant} shirt?
kb.q.sponsor: Whose name was across the chest in {season}?
kb.info.colours: {name}: the first colour is the body of the shirt, the second (if there is one) is the trim and pattern.
kb.info.maker: {name} is one of the makers in this club's documented kits. The name is lettered on the shirt; the artwork of a brand is never redrawn here.
kb.info.sponsor: {name} appears as a shirt sponsor in this club's documented kits. It is lettered across the chest.
kb.info.seen: Worn on {n} of the club's {of} drawable kits.
kb.hint.aria: Hint: strike out one wrong card, costs {pts} points. {left} left.
kb.hint.none: No more cards can be struck out here.
kb.hint.struck: One wrong card struck out. {n} hints left on this shirt.
kb.rules.title: How it works
kb.rules.body: Dress the blank shirt with one card per part. You can change any part until you press Check — the real shirt stays hidden.
kb.rules.tap: Tap a card to place it, or drag it up onto the shirt.
kb.rules.hint: A hint strikes out one wrong card and costs {pts} points (up to {max} per shirt).
kb.rules.score: 100 points per shirt, split across its parts. A perfect shirt earns {bonus} extra.
kb.auto: Move to the next part after each tap
kb.review.title: Happy with it? Tap any part to change it.
kb.err.invalid: That could not be checked. Your choices are kept — try again.
kb.err.stale: This club's archive was updated while you played. Reload to get a fresh round.
kb.err.locked: This game is closed for the club right now.
kb.reveal.recon: Drawn from the documented colours, design, maker and sponsor — a reconstruction, not a photograph. Details the archive does not state (collar, sleeves, crest) are left plain.
kb.reveal.unlocked: This shirt is now open in your collection →
kb.cert.title: Round complete
kb.cert.fine: {perfect} perfect build(s) in {n}. The shirts you assembled are open in your collection.
kb.share.text: {club} — Build the Kit: {score} points, {perfect} perfect build(s) in {n}.
